:::{#def-zero-matrix}
#### Zero matrix

The $m \times n$ **zero matrix** $\matr{0}_{m \times n}$
(or $\matr{0}$ when dimensions are clear from context)
has all entries equal to zero:

$$
\matr{0}_{m \times n} =
\begin{bmatrix}
0      & 0      & \cdots & 0      \\
0      & 0      & \cdots & 0      \\
\vdots & \vdots & \ddots & \vdots \\
0      & 0      & \cdots & 0
\end{bmatrix}
$$

:::

{{< slidebreak >}}

:::{#exm-zero-matrix}
#### Zero matrices of two shapes

$$
\matr{0}_{2 \times 3} = \begin{bmatrix} 0 & 0 & 0 \\ 0 & 0 & 0 \end{bmatrix},
\qquad
\matr{0}_{3 \times 2} = \begin{bmatrix} 0 & 0 \\ 0 & 0 \\ 0 & 0 \end{bmatrix}.
$$

They have the same entries but different dimensions, so they are different matrices.

:::
